ts.summary: Modular ES Modules with NodeNext extensions
ts.doDirective: Always use explicit .js extension in relative imports for ES2022/NodeNext runtime compatibility.
ts.dontDirective: Do not omit file extensions in local TypeScript relative module paths.

ts.doDirective: Create isolated temp scratch directories for file system test runs to avoid race conditions.
ts.dontDirective: Never write unit test outputs to production directories.

ts.summary: Surgical Diff Application with Exact Anchors
ts.doDirective: When applying patches, match at least 3 lines of contextual anchor before and after changes.
ts.dontDirective: Do not perform greedy multi-line regex replacements without boundary limits.

js.doDirective: Export async handler(req, res) directly without heavy Express wrapper frameworks in serverless functions.
Wrap all asynchronous I/O operations in try-catch with specific fallback handling.

py.summary: Strict Type Annotations and Protocol Classes
py.doDirective: Include typing.Optional, typing.Union, and TypedDict in all function interfaces.

py.summary: Generator Pipelines for Large Data Streams
py.doDirective: Yield items lazily using generators instead of building massive in-memory lists.

rs.doDirective: Use &str slices and lifetimes instead of allocating String instances inside inner parsing loops.
Represent all domain failure states as distinct enum variants with descriptive messages.

go.summary: Bounded Worker Pool with Context Cancellation
go.doDirective: Always pass context.Context to goroutines and select on ctx.Done() to prevent goroutine leaks.
